The National Weather Service in Midland/Odessa has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Lea County in southeastern New Mexico...
Southwestern Andrews County in western Texas...
Northeastern Winkler County in western Texas...

* Until 1230 AM MDT /130 AM CDT/.

redeveloping across the warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Jal and Jal Airport.

Monument Draw.
